title: How Gritty Are You?
coreMove: Audit whether a commitment has lasted long enough to count as direction instead of intensity.
sourcePressure: Make grit observable as consistency of passion plus perseverance, not short-term strain.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking a hard week, a startup sprint, or a high score proves grit.

sourceAnchors.name: Grit Scale
sourceAnchors.detail: The scale asks people to rate ten statements and separates passion from perseverance while reminding readers that self-report is imperfect.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A score can start the conversation, but it cannot replace the slower evidence of what someone keeps choosing.

sourceAnchors.name: Jeffrey Gettleman
sourceAnchors.detail: Gettleman’s path to East Africa took about a decade and illustrates passion as a compass rather than a flash.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Gettleman did not need fireworks; he needed a compass that kept pointing toward East Africa.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
